hub.title: Projects
hub.intro: Pixel Kiln is the tool. A project is a folder with a studio.project.json: its palette, sizes and assets. Open one, or make a new one.
hub.empty: No projects yet. Open a folder below, or make a new project from a template.
hub.removeHint: Only removes it from this list. No file is deleted.
hub.removeConfirm: Remove “{name}” from the list? Its folder and files are not deleted.
hub.pathHelp: The full path to a folder that holds studio.project.json. It is checked against the project schema before it is opened.
hub.tpl.blank.about: a small starter palette and no assets
hub.tpl.moss-lantern.about: the sample project with a palette, sizes and clips
hub.tpl.unavailable: not part of this copy of Pixel Kiln
hub.newHelp: Type the full path of a folder that does not exist yet (its parent must exist) or is empty. Nothing is overwritten.
hub.err.not_found: There is no folder at that path.
hub.err.not_a_directory: That path is a file, not a folder.
hub.err.no_pack: That folder has no studio.project.json, so it is not a Pixel Kiln project.
hub.err.invalid_pack: The project file does not match the project schema:
hub.err.path_not_absolute: Type the full path, starting from the root of the disk.
hub.err.invalid_path: That path is not accepted. Type a real path without “..”.
hub.err.dir_not_empty: That folder is not empty. Choose a new or empty folder.
hub.err.parent_missing: The folder that should hold the project does not exist.
hub.err.stale_pack: The project file changed since you opened these settings. Reload the page and try again.
hub.err.owner_decision_required: Licence profile and quota are decisions of the project owner. Tick the confirmation to apply them.
hub.err.unknown_project: That project is no longer in the list.
hub.set.title: Settings of {name}
hub.set.intro: These are written to studio.project.json after the same schema check as loading a project. The previous file is kept as a revision first.
hub.set.name: Project name
hub.set.markHelp: One or two characters shown in the rail.
hub.set.sizesHelp: Class name → sizes [w, h] or min/max. A frame that fits no class is refused.
hub.set.ownerNote: The licence profile and the quota are decided by the project owner, not by this tool or an agent. Change them only when the owner has decided.
hub.set.licenceHelp: Which licences an asset's recorded rights may carry. Shown in the Atlas hand-off check.
hub.set.quotaHelp: The ceiling on image-tool and toolchain runs. An empty ceilings object means no ceiling was set on purpose.
hub.set.ownerConfirm: The project owner decided this change to the licence profile or the quota.
hub.set.revisionNote: The file is rewritten as standard JSON (two-space indent); its content keeps its order.
